hints.title: Monotonicity Over Elapsed Time
hints.text: Notice that if the coverage criteria is met at time t, it remains satisfied for all times greater than t.

hints.title: Feasibility Verification Function
hints.text: Given a fixed time threshold, mark active indices and check if consecutive inactive elements stay below k.

hints.title: Binary Halving
hints.text: Halve the candidate time interval repeatedly until pinpointing the minimal valid elapsed seconds.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: M: Length of activation order array
complexity.notes: Binary searches the answer space with a linear O(N) validity check per probe.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Incrementing time sequentially tests up to M times, taking O(N * M) overall.
